This works nicely. I put the CSS Grid card away with a single click — no scary warning, which is right since nothing's being destroyed — and it dropped out of my main list. Over in the Put away view it was still there, whole and unchanged, with a "Restore to library" button right on it. I restored it, went back to All bookmarks, and there it was again. That reversible tuck-away-and-bring-back is exactly the gentler option I was hoping for alongside permanent delete.

One related thing I want to confirm, since it's part of what "out of my way" means to me: when something's put away, I'd expect it to stay out of my everyday searches too, not just the main list. So if I search my normal collection, a put-away bookmark shouldn't pop up in the results — I'd only come across it when I go into the Put away area itself. Is that how it behaves? If so, I'm happy with this.
